mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail, is_default, created_at, updated_at FROM user_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail, is_default, created_at, updated_at FROM user_address WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_address WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_address (user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail, is_default) VALUES (#{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detail}, #{isDefault})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_address SET receiver_name = #{receiverName}, receiver_phone = #{receiverPhone}, province = #{province}, city = #{city}, district = #{district}, detail = #{detail}, is_default = #{isDefault} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_address WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_address SET is_default = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user_address SET is_default = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
